purpose: One finite session of official public source originals for migration research; not production integration
reason: Existing project requires actual whole/provider admission; native BINGX durable DB grant is absent. This proposed one-off exception avoids all D1/Cloudflare calls and keeps production guards unchanged.

requests.retain: native fields/contractId/symbol/asset/currency/status/apiStateOpen/size/metadata and original body clock/hash; no assetType inferred

requests.requires: exact native catalog record and independently known Bitcoin crypto identity

requests.window: Explicit last closed minute at native server cut; exact startTime/endTime computed from retained serverTime before request

requests.unit: Keep raw; no multiplication or conversion until unit independently qualified

requests.purpose: Retain at most three native historical funding rows; no period or future funding inference

body_cap_kind: RAW_HTTP_BODY_IDENTITY_ENCODING_ONLY; reject unsupported compression, do not claim decoded/wire equivalence
raw_originals: localtmp/approved artifact only, sanitized count/clock/hash receipts in Git
request_timestamp: Explicit outbound local request_ts in milliseconds, not fact source_ts
